notes.zh-CN: 发送失败不再丢字：消息被拒时草稿和附件回到输入框，并说明原因。Agent 用 [1] [2] 列出选项时直接点选就能回复。修复流式生成中表格横向滚动被重置、活动块与工具卡宽度不一致的问题，标题层级更紧凑。后台回合结束时会响一声「嗒·嗒—咔」的完成提示音。
notes.en: A refused message no longer disappears: the draft and attachments go back into the composer with the reason. When an agent lists options as [1] [2], they become buttons you can pick. Fixed the table's horizontal scroll resetting while streaming, matched activity rows to tool-card width, and tightened heading sizes. A finished background turn now plays a soft two-knock chime with a seed crack.
